0x001F98.en: 「I'll show you a thing or two!」

0x00200E.en: 「No one lays a hand on you.../ you're my prey!」

0x002092.en: 「Girl... don't push your luck!/ I'll make you hurt!」

0x0020E2.en: 「Kid... war's no playground!/ Tuck your tail and run home!」

0x002144.en: 「A surface mech, huh.../ how odd. That's one strange taste you've got.」

0x0021A9.en: 「What is that thing, anyway?/ Beats me why it's so hung up on looking human.」

0x002214.en: 「You think war's your playground!?/ I'll teach you better!」

0x00227C.en: 「Shu Shirakawa... a dangerous foe./ Better keep my guard up.」

0x0022F0.en: 「Tch, the famous Granzon./ A worthy opponent, here I come!」

0x002355.en: 「You lot are scheming plenty,/ but the world's not that easy!」

0x0023DB.en: 「Saphine of the Crimson, huh./ A fine woman, but a nasty streak.」

0x00243A.en: 「There's a bounty on that one, right?/ Nice bonus, I'll take it!」

0x0024B4.en: 「Saphine,/ no time to play with you!/ Let's end this quick!」

0x00252C.en: 「Surface dweller, I've got a surprise for you!」

0x002582.en: 「You picked the wrong side to back!」

0x0025C2.en: 「Don't stick your nose in,/ surface dweller!」

0x00260C.en: 「I won't let you surface folk/ do as you please anymore!」

0x002659.en: 「I see, this one's a real prize!」

0x002693.en: 「Cybuster! I'll show you a thing or two!」

0x0026D0.en: 「Masoukishin Cybuster.../ I'll smash you to bits!」

0x00271A.en: 「Take down Cybuster and/ my stock skyrockets!/ Now, here I come!」

0x002798.en: 「Masoukishin this, Masoukishin that, shut it!/ Specs alone won't win you this!」

0x00280F.en: 「A Masoukishin's not invincible!/ Keep hitting it and I've got a shot!」

0x00288F.en: 「Gaddess... bottom of the barrel among the Masoukishin.」

0x0028D2.en: 「Masoukishin Gaddess, huh.../ Well, not a bad machine!」

0x002922.en: 「Whoa, Granveil./ Its firepower's a pain./ Better end this fast.」

0x0029A6.en: 「Firepower or not, Granveil's no threat/ once I take it down first!」

0x002A17.en: 「Granveil's weakness is its thin armor.../ so I'll strike first and end it!」

0x002A94.en: 「What's a pile-driver like that gonna do?」

0x002B33.en: 「That thing's a mash-up of all sorts!」

0x002C1C.en: 「Wanna tangle with me? Then brace yourself!」

0x002E30.en: 「Damn... did I push my luck too far?」

0x002E64.en: 「Gwah!!/ Y-you did it.../ but I'm not beaten yet!」

0x002F11.en: 「Guuh...!/ Going head-on with Granzon/ is a losing game...!」

0x002F80.en: 「Gwaah!! Damn it!/ Getting worked over by S-Saphine...!」

0x002FEE.en: 「I can't lose/ to a surface dweller!!」

0x00307B.en: 「Looks like you've survived/ some real hell on the surface...!」

0x003242.en: 「Guh!/ I'll snap that sword of yours for sure!」

0x003292.en: 「H-heh, looks like you missed the kill...!」

0x0033EF.en: 「Not bad!/ Now it's worth crushing you!」

0x0034E4.en: 「What!? That kid actually/ landed a clean hit!?」

0x003531.en: 「Tch, fooled by looks?/ You've got some good gear!」

0x00358D.en: 「Tch, so this is Granzon's power.../ not to be underestimated!」

0x0035D4.en: 「Whoa, you're better than I thought,/ Saphine!」

0x00364C.en: 「Guh! I'll give you credit, surface dweller!」

0x00378A.en: 「Damn, what kind of flying is that,/　that guy!」

0x0037D4.en: 「Not bad, Gaddess!/　Now that's more like it!」

0x00382D.en: 「I see, you've got good power,/　Granveil!」

0x003A1E.en: 「What's wrong, what's wrong?/　Is that your full power?」

0x003AB8.en: 「Hmph, so hung up on some weird gimmick/　you forgot how to hit hard?」

0x003BFC.en: 「Maybe that worked/　back on the surface!」

0x003C89.en: 「Hmph, you're less than the rumors, Cybuster!」

0x003D00.en: 「That's a disgrace to the Masou Kishin's name!」

0x003D80.en: 「You're a Gaddess, and this is all you've got!?」

0x003DBA.en: 「Hey, wasn't attack power your selling/　point, Granveil?」

0x003F57.en: 「Whoa! Your hit looked like it'd sting.」

0x003F97.en: 「Ha, that's what playing gets you, Saphine!」

0x00401A.en: 「Hmph, what a waste of power,/　Granveil!」

0x00417F.en: 「Just to be sure, one more for ya!」
